what: Side-by-side cells stand tilted at a -12° slant, and when you hover one, it widens to flex 3 while the others recede to .42 opacity (.48s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), opacity .32s). The label below each cell stands as upright text (skew cancelled) and disappears at .22s only in the widened cell

options.--fx-grow: flex-grow of the widened cell, default 3

note: Uses CSS only (:has·:hover·:focus-visible). On touch devices only the tilt is applied and nothing widens. If a diagonal tick between cells is needed, put a 1px line of the same slope on the cell boundary (width ratio 3:1:1:1) — karma-brand index.js is an example

from.where: index.html .kc__row (four-way cells) — original SlotRow: skewX(-12deg), flex-grow 1→3 480ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), the others opacity .42 320ms, label skewX(12deg) 10px .24em transparent .42→0 220ms
